newsitem.title: USA: Ohio corn/soybean conditions improve last week.
newsitem.headline: Ohio corn/soybean conditions improve last week.

text.p: Corn and soybean conditions improved during the week ended Sunday, according to the Ohio Agricultural Statistics Service.
Corn conditions as of Sunday were 68 percent good to excellent, above the 66 percent in that category the previous week.
Soybean conditions showed a sharp improvement during the week to 65 percent good to excellent, above the 57 percent in that category the previous week.
Twenty-one percent of the corn crop had silked as of Sunday, above the 13 percent a year ago and behind the 45 percent average silking pace.
Seventy-eight percent of the soybean crop was blooming as of Sunday, above the 33 percent a year ago and above the 64 percent average pace.
Eighty-four percent of the winter wheat crop had been harvested as of Sunday, below the 91 percent a year ago and equal to the average pace of 84 percent.
Topsoil moisture supplies were 11 percent very short, 24 percent short, 57 percent adequate and eight percent surplus.
